title: Zesty Smoky Croatian Pork Skewers
description: Smoky and crispy Croatian dish featuring yuzu, perfect for a comforting dinner, this recipe is also gluten-free-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and toss to coat, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat, threading the marinated pork cubes onto skewers if using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes before grilling.
Grill the pork skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar and 1 tablespoon of water to make a glaze.
Brush the glaze onto the pork skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Once the pork is cooked, remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the pork skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or rosemary if desired.
